final: WITH joined AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END AS signed_amt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id), acct AS (SELECT account_id, region, SUM(signed_amt) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY account_id, region), reg AS (SELECT region, SUM(total) AS region_total FROM acct GROUP BY region), res AS (SELECT acct.account_id AS account_id, acct.region AS region, acct.total AS total, acct.cnt AS cnt, CAST(acct.total AS REAL) / reg.region_total AS ratio FROM acct JOIN reg ON reg.region = acct.region) SELECT account_id, region, total, cnt, ratio FROM res ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
